rollback_evidence: xe access control (XE-M030), measured on IOL XE 17.18.2 (router) in the virtual topology. The key is <interface>:ipv4|ipv6:in|out of a routed interface (Ethernet port, subinterface, port-channel or SVI). Update acl with the name of an existing non-empty extended ACL of the family or null to remove the attachment. Lines: 'ip access-group NAME in|out' and 'ipv6 traffic-filter NAME in|out' replace the ACL of the same direction without an unfiltered interval, 'no ip access-group NAME in|out' and 'no ipv6 traffic-filter NAME in|out' remove it. The safeguard is the revert timer of the interface profile; apply needs the approved expected_plan_sha256. An up interface needs endpoint_impact naming the key; the management interface, a protected interface, a port-channel member and a Layer 2 port are refused. The check account reads show ip interface and show ipv6 interface.
